name: Fungal hitchhiker

fieldPatches.label: Gel patch (sugar 0.5 and nutrient 0.2 per cell)

founders.label: Threadriders, each next to one of the first five Cordweavers

question: What does a Threadrider take from a Cordweaver?
expectedObservationsText: Ten Cordweavers on a small gel patch with sugar and nutrient, and five Threadriders, each starting next to one of the first five Cordweavers. A Threadrider that touches a free Cordweaver rides it and drains carbon from its body; it cannot feed any other way. The experiment card makes a copy without the Cordweavers, with the Threadriders in the same places.
